data.message: I opt in to 18 tons this month, not an all-or-nothing deal. Each of the other 24: state your exact intended catch and whether it depends on others. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250-8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500-16k (25%). Switching adds $8,000 now if fulfilled, but cuts remainder by8 and low-recovery stock by16. Even all18 leaves50, avoiding collapse this month, not guaranteeing future recovery or best long-run income. Intentions aren't binding; other catches need recalculation.
